# Digital War Room

> AI-Powered OSINT Intelligence Platform — multi-agent system monitoring global conflicts across GEOINT, SIGINT, SOCMINT, FININT and TECHINT.

## About

- [Homepage](https://digital-war-room.com): Real-time conflict escalation dashboard
- [How It Works](https://digital-war-room.com/how-it-works): Architecture and intelligence streams
- [Methodology](https://digital-war-room.com/methodology): Scoring weights and threat-level thresholds
- [Source Directory](https://digital-war-room.com/sources): All data sources with reliability ratings
- [Daily Briefing](https://digital-war-room.com/daily-briefing): BLUF-style daily intelligence report
